# A Runtime That Must Keep Running

<!-- Canonical contract: docs/CHAPTER-OUTLINES.md, Chapter 4. -->

<!-- Opening problem: What must continue to operate when the learned component
does not? -->

::: {.callout-objective}
After this chapter, you will be able to organize a continuously running system
so that sensing, state, action checks, and recovery continue to meet their
requirements when the learned component is late, stale, restarted, or
unavailable.
:::

## Choose How the Runtime Is Organized

Choose which services are separate, which service owns each state, how often
each service runs, what happens during overload, and how failures are handled.

Record the runtime structure, service responsibilities, recovery states, and
measurement points.
:::

::: {.callout-lab}
## Let the Policy Fail

Make a learned service late, hung, and unavailable. Measure event age and
recovery while the rest of the runtime continues to sense, check freshness, and
respect its action and authority limits.
:::
